Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- Each suite changes only the fixture load. No assert changes and no tolerance widens. `whole_model_pocket.rs` keeps `R - CHORD` for both the debug test and the new twin.
- Only the Adaptive strategy reads `optimal_load` (`crates/app/src/cutting.rs:51-55`). The shared `pocket()` helpers in `climb_direction.rs` and `pocket_overhead.rs` can set 0.4 for every strategy: the other strategies ignore the field.
- The new `#[ignore]`d twin names its lane: "heavy lane (release)". Its ignore reason gives the time and the issue.
- Default-load coverage stands: the new twin plus the existing release-lane test of `adaptive_pinch` (`the_users_part_with_default_adaptive_keeps_the_cutter_off_it`, seed params).
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1716-lighter-hsm-fixtures.md` follows the format in `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- No golden file, no source file, and no process file changes. The PR body is complete: what changed, times, mutation checks, how tested, not exercised, `Changelog: none`, and the closing keyword.
- The mutation table in the PR body shows each law still fails its test at load 0.4. This review did not repeat the mutation runs.

## Results

Built on the self-hosted runner through pr-test.yml (run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43649716966), merged with main at 0db66c44e:

- Quick gate, merged tree: the four suites `adaptive_pinch`, `climb_direction`, `pocket_overhead`, `whole_model_pocket` selected and ran as whole suites. Result: ok, 47 s, 0 failed. Wall 0.8 min.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Trial merge with main: no conflict; the PR reports MERGEABLE.

Built locally (Windows worktree, merged tree), the release-lane test the author did not run:

- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test whole_model_pocket -- --ignored --exact a_whole_part_adaptive_at_the_default_load_keeps_the_full_tool_radius_off_the_part` — ok, 1 passed, 21.65 s.

The known flake in `import_step_guard.rs` was not part of these suites and did not appear.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes

- The runner is macOS. The author ran the four debug binaries on Windows. The diff adds no `cfg(windows)` reading, so no extra local debug run was owed.
- Issue 1716 asked for under 30 s per binary in debug. The body reports 1.7 s, 9.1 s, 6.0 s and 8.2 s.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
